title: Publishing skips the full checklist: no per-language checklist, and imported or pod Stories get all steps not applicable
description: Ryan 2026-11-19: content is getting published that has not been through the whole checklist, and localizations make it worse. Findings from reading publishing.py, story_checklist.py, localization_publish.py on develop: (1) A translation skips require_checklist_closed entirely: publishing.publish_item calls only require_publishable (original published + no unanswered hold), so a translation's translate/faithfulness/copy-edit steps are 'proven by the run records' and nothing ticks per language; a person-imported or hand-corrected translation (stories correct-translation, imports) has no checklist steps at all. (2) Imported Stories (and pod-loaded Stories since #1691) get a checklist with every step but publishing marked not applicable, so they pass the gate with no review. (3) Rating/illustration gates are the original's only. Wanted: one checklist per language lineage ({story}--{language}), with template steps that apply to a translation (translate, faithfulness, copy edit, human review where the site requires it, rating served by the original), checked on that language's version at publish; the review_people stamp (PPY-97c0f2, provisional) and Always-on agent memory read these per-language rows. Decide the design before building; do not add a fallback. Needs Gherkin for each language case.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Shipped first, PR 1730 (merged to develop): one named rule, src/papyrus_content/publish_by_person.py, called once by publish_item before every other gate. A pod-loaded Story, an imported Story or a translation publishes only when a person publishes by hand (console, or CLI signed in as a person); everything else is refused with person-publish-required (details.storyKind) and words that say how to proceed. Pod load leaves a draft and reports it, import-markus saves Stories as drafts (reported as storiesForAPerson), automatic translation (languages.auto publish:true, --publish-clean), schedules (refused when made), restore/un-retire and agents leave a ready draft. Recorded in docs/releasing.md and docs/story-translation-procedure.md. This block is lifted by the per-language checklist gate (the follow-up of this ticket): delete publish_by_person.py, its one call in publish_item and the by_person argument. Ticket stays open for that gate.
